item.title: Solution Architect (Bilingual French/English)
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

Building a diverse team with a wide range of experiences, skills, and backgrounds has always been central to Teamtailor’s mission, and it remains a strength today. We welcome all individuals who share our vision and are committed to contributing to our collective success. Join us in helping companies and people communicate in more meaningful ways to make life-changing decisions together.👫

We are now seeking a Solution Architect to join our Team based in Stockholm.

A Solution Architect is the technical and solution expert in Teamtailor's sales process. They partner with Account Executives on complex enterprise deals to secure the technical win: understanding the customer's recruitment process and HR tech stack, designing how Teamtailor fits into it, and proving it through tailored demos and solution designs. They lead integration, API, security and data privacy discussions in pre-sales, and make sure every deal is handed over to onboarding with a clear, realistic solution plan. They also turn what they learn in deals into repeatable assets and feed customer insights back to Product. This is a senior individual contributor role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical win in complex deals: Partner with Account Executives on mid-market and enterprise opportunities, leading discovery, technical qualification and solution design to secure the technical win, according to the pipeline and targets in your market. While the Account Executive owns the customer relationship, forecast and commercial negotiation, the Solution Architect is responsible for the solution design, technical consultancy and ecosystem integration needs analysis and solutions.

  • Solution design & tailored demos: Map the customer's recruitment process and current tech stack, and design how Teamtailor solves their specific needs. Run tailored, value-focused demos and workshops for talent acquisition, HR, IT and procurement stakeholder together with the AE

  • Integrations & ecosystem: Act as the go-to expert on Teamtailor's API, Marketplace partners and integrations (e.g. HRIS, SSO, job boards, assessments). Scope non-standard requirements and propose creative but realistic solutions.

  • Security, privacy & RFPs: Work with the Proposal team on RFPs and tenders as the technical expert, contributing to compelling bids and supporting security and data privacy questions (including GDPR) together with Legal and Security. The Proposal team owns the bid process; the Solutions Architect contributes to the technical solution.

  • Clean handover to onboarding: Document pre-sales findings, agreed solutions and integration scope, and hand over to the onboarding team so customers get what was promised. Ownership of implementation sits with onboarding, not this role.

  • Voice of the customer: Feed structured customer and market insights back to Product, including gaps, feature requests and competitive input, based on what you see in deals.

  • Scalable assets & enablement: Build reusable demo environments, solution blueprints and reference architectures, and help train Account Executives so they can handle standard technical questions on their own.

We are looking for someone with:

  • Strong technical understanding of B2B SaaS, including APIs, integrations, SSO and data flows, and the ability to explain them in simple, business-friendly language.

  • Excellent discovery and consultative skills: you can uncover the real problem behind a request and connect it to business value. Able to break down complex or unclear requirements and find practical workarounds within the product’s capabilities.

  • Strong commercial mindset: a deep understanding of the customer's needs, and the ability to present solutions with the confidence of a great salesperson, but backed by deeper expertise and credibility, so customers see you as a trusted advisor rather than a seller.

  • Outstanding presentation and demo skills, comfortable in front of senior and technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and in a team-selling setup with Account Executives.

  • Assertive communicator who sets clear, realistic expectations and is comfortable challenging customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Structured and organised, able to run several deals in parallel and document clearly.

  • Fluency in English and French, written and spoken.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to work for a leading employer branding and recruitment platform. 🥰

  • Professional growth in a fast-growing environment, with ongoing training & support.🎗️

  • The opportunity to collaborate with a talented and supportive team.🎤

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

item.title: Head of Marketing - North America
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

Teamtailor is growing in North America, and we’re looking for a Head of Marketing to define how we win here. You’ll be our first senior marketing leader on the ground representing US & Canada, setting the NA marketing strategy and acting as the voice of the market to our global teams in Sweden.

This is a director-level individual contributor role. You will have the backing of our global Brand & Creative, Product Marketing, and Growth teams. Your job is to decide what the North American market needs, make the case for it clearly to global stakeholders, and then drive it forward, hands-on where it counts.

Key Responsibilities:

Build and own the NA marketing strategy

  • Develop the go-to-market and marketing strategy for the North America, covering brand, product marketing, and demand generation

  • Identify what the NA market needs from us (positioning, messaging, content, channels, partnerships, product priorities) and build the business case for it

  • Translate market realities into clear recommendations for global leadership, and align global priorities with what will work locally

  • Set the NA marketing roadmap, goals, and KPIs, and report openly on what is working and what isn’t

Be the bridge between NA and global

  • Represent the North American market in global planning, launches, and roadmap conversations

  • Partner with the Creative Director and global Brand & Creative team to adapt our brand, voice, and narrative for NA while keeping our value proposition consistent worldwide

Brand and product marketing

  • Own how Teamtailor shows up in North America: awareness, credibility, and reputation through campaigns, events, partnerships, PR, thought leadership, and customer stories

  • Develop positioning and messaging for products, features, and use cases across NA segments

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with messaging, battlecards, enablement, and customer-facing narratives

Content and demand generation

  • Build a content engine that supports both brand and pipeline: SEO, blog, guides and reports, webinars, email, case studies, and social

  • Plan and run multi-channel campaigns that move target accounts from awareness to opportunity

  • Define lead quality, handoff, and follow-up with Sales, and optimize the funnel from first touch to closed-won

Customer and market insight

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, market trends, and competitive intelligence, and share it internally as the voice of the NA customer

  • Spot gaps in awareness, positioning, or adoption and turn them into concrete initiatives

  • Use data to measure brand reach, content engagement, campaign performance, and adoption

We are looking for someone who:

Is a senior marketer who can set direction and also execute. You can move from a boardroom narrative to a funnel dashboard, and you’re confident presenting a strategy to global leadership and then building it yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, and you build momentum without needing a big team around you.

  • Has 6+ years of B2B marketing experience in SaaS, with hands-on depth across brand, product marketing, content, and demand generation

  • Has a track record of owning marketing strategy and execution end to end, as a solo marketer, an early regional leader, or in a startup-style environment

  • Has experience building a market strategy and securing buy-in from senior or global stakeholders

  • A strong commercial mindset and a clear understanding of how brand and product communication drive pipeline and adoption

  • Has experience running content and demand programs from strategy and production through measurement

  • Has strong analytical skills and comfort with marketing analytics, customer insights, and product data

Bonus if you

  • Have experience in HR tech or recruiting software

  • Have worked with scaling international B2B companies, or with a global HQ across time zones

  • Have experience with marketing automation, SEO, and attribution tools

  • Have driven product adoption or onboarding initiatives

  • Have strong instincts for positioning and packaging products in competitive markets

What we offer:

• The opportunity to work for a leading employer branding and recruitment platform. 🥰

• Professional growth in a fast-growing environment, with ongoing training & support.🎗️

• The opportunity to collaborate with a talented and supportive team.🎤

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

item.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager - Chicago
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 200,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

As a Strategic Partnerships Manager at Teamtailor, you'll be the founding force behind our North American partner ecosystem, a role that combines tech and channel partnerships to drive real commercial impact in the US. This is a builder's role with serious revenue upside, you'll take Teamtailor's global partnerships strategy and playbook and bring it to life locally.

The role

We have a handful of partners in the US already but in terms of a structured revenue generating ecosystem, we're starting from scratch and we are looking for the right player to help build the market. You'll be part of our global Partnerships team, and your core job is to take our global strategy and playbook and deploy it at a local level, adapting it to what works in the US market.

In the first 6–12 months, you'll be deep in discovery and build mode: mapping the landscape, identifying the right partners, reaching out, onboarding, and activating. From there, your mission shifts to keeping partners engaged, growing their revenue contribution, and continually expanding the portfolio.

You'll work toward clear revenue and lead generation targets for building partnerships that generate real revenue in the US market, using the global playbook as your foundation and applying judgment on how best to execute it locally. You'll operate as part of the GTM team in the US, where the ability to communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders at a strategic level matters just as much as your ability to execute day to day. If you're the kind of person who sees a problem and immediately starts solving it rather than escalating it, this role was written for you.

You'll report to our Team Manager of Partnerships and work closely with the global Partnerships team, as well as regional Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership teams across North America.

What you'll do 🤓

  • Build and grow a high-performing, revenue-generating portfolio of tech and channel partnerships from the ground up, owning your revenue number end-to-end

  • Take Teamtailor's global partnerships strategy and playbook and deploy it at a local level, adapting it to the US market

  • Develop and manage long-term strategic relationships, and lead thinking on how partnerships accelerate growth in your region and then go execute it

  • Operate as part of the US GTM team: work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional leadership, and communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders on how to support market growth through partnerships

  • Stay sharp on industry trends, competitive benchmarks, and the Teamtailor product, and own partner marketing activities in your region

  • Roll up your sleeves. This role rewards resourcefulness as much as strategy.

  • Travel for events and to meet with partners will be required for this role

What we offer you 🥳

  • ✨ The chance to represent the market-leading employer branding and recruitment platform

  • 💰 Competitive base salary plus an uncapped bonus structure that genuinely rewards performance

  • 🏢 A stunning home base at 125 S Clark Street, Chicago — our flagship HQ where the team comes together three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday), with flexibility, for real collaboration (and a lot of fun)

  • 🏃 Real development opportunities in a fast-growing global company, with ongoing training and support

  • 🏝 Unlimited PTO and an invite to our all inclusive annual 4-day company trip to a secret summer destination

🍾 Team events, weekly competitions & rewards to keep things interesting

What we're looking for

  • A proven track record building tech and/or channel partnerships in the SaaS space, with the commercial drive to work toward revenue targets

  • High execution power, you've mastered qualification, discovery, partner activation, and nurturing, with a proven track record of turning strong partnerships into pipeline at previous companies

  • A scrappy, resourceful problem-solver who executes independently. You diagnose what's not working, adapt fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions

  • Strong relationship-building skills with a consultative approach, comfortable communicating and collaborating with senior stakeholders at a strategic level, and confident representing the brand at external events

  • Tech-savvy and intellectually curious, ideally with experience in the HR tech space

  • Based in Chicago and able to work from our flagship HQ 3 days a week

Your attitude matters most 🔥

We're less focused on a perfect resume and more focused on finding someone with the hunger to build, the grit to push through ambiguity, and the smarts to take a global playbook and make it work locally. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.
